scenes.text: Gemini's new *tasks mode* keeps working *while you're away*

scenes.title: What *changed*
lines: Oct 13: Gemini 4 Argon reached the Gemini app for AI Pro and Ultra, with a chat-or-tasks switch.
In tasks mode it keeps working across your Google apps and 40-plus connected apps: Shopify, Instacart, OpenTable, Adobe.

scenes.title: The *money* use
lines: Shop owners: 'Every morning, check my Shopify orders, draft the low-stock reorder list and email it to me.'
Google's own examples: order groceries, book tables, design and build a business.

scenes.title: *Tested*, not hyped
lines: Paid plans only; the free tier does not get Argon.
Agents make mistakes with real orders. Start with drafts, not purchases. Source: Google, Oct 13; 9to5Google, Oct 13, 2026.

scenes.title: The *cost*
lines: Google AI Pro is $19.99 a month. Ultra costs more and unlocks the coding tools.
One useful morning task pays for the plan if it saves you 30 minutes a day.

scenes.text: What task would you *hand off* first? Comment it.
